# Transcriptomics

Preserve the requested method, contrast, identifiers, enrichment source, and
statistical population. These are parts of the estimand, not interchangeable
output formats.

## Differential Expression

- Match count-matrix sample IDs to metadata before fitting. Confirm the design
  formula, covariates, reference and target levels, and contrast direction.
- Use raw counts for count-model methods unless the named method specifies a
  different input. Do not treat normalized or transformed abundance as counts.
- Use the matched experimental control. Do not replace a vehicle, batch-matched,
  or paired control with another baseline unless the task defines that contrast.
- Pre

  hits <- intersect(fg, pathway_genes)
  cat('"'hits n', length(hits), '\\n')
  cat(paste(sort(hits), collapse='\\n'), '\\n')
}

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
x<-readRDS('inputs/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.rds')
ld<-attr(x,'listData', exact=TRUE)
df<-data.frame(gene=attr(x,'rownames', exact=TRUE), log2FoldChange=ld"'$log2FoldChange, padj=ld$padj, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
fg<-df$gene[!is.na(df$padj) & df$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(df$log2FoldChange) & df$log2FoldChange > 1.5]
fetch <- function(url){ tf<-tempfile(); download.file(url, tf, quiet=TRUE); read.delim(tf, header=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE) }
links <- fetch('"'https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau')
names <- fetch('https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau')
colnames(links) <- c('gene','pathway')
links"'$gene <- sub('"'"'^pau:'"', '', links"'$gene)
links$pathway <- sub('"'"'^path:'"', '', links"'$pathway)
colnames(names) <- c('"'pathway','description')
names"'$pathway <- sub('"'"'^path:'"', '', names"'$pathway)
# Universe: DE table genes that map to at least one KEGG PA14 pathway.
universe <- intersect(df$gene, unique(links$gene))
fgm <- intersect(fg, universe)
M <- length(universe); N <- length(fgm)
res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(links$gene, links$pathway), function(gs){
  gs <- intersect(unique(gs), universe)
  k <- sum(fgm %in% gs); n <- length(gs)
  data.frame(pathway=unique(links$pathway[links$gene %in% gs])[1], n=n, k=k, pvalue=phyper(k-1, n, M-n, N, lower.tail=FALSE))
}))
# The split path assignment above can be brittle after intersect; recompute simpler
res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(split(links$gene, links$pathway)), function(pid){
  gs <- intersect(unique(links$gene[links$pathway==pid]), universe)
  k <- sum(fgm %in% gs); n <- length(gs)
  data.frame(pathway=pid, n=n, k=k, pvalue=phyper(k-1, n, M-n, N, lower.tail=FALSE))
}))
res$padj <- p.adjust(res$pvalue, method='"'BH')
res <- merge(res, names, by='pathway', all.x=TRUE)
res <- res[order(res"'$pvalue),]
cat('"'DE genes', nrow(df), 'mapped universe', M, 'foreground', length(fg), 'mapped foreground', N, '\\n')
print(head(res, 20), row.names=FALSE)
cat('ABC row:\\n')
print(res[grep('ABC transporters', res"'$description, fixed=TRUE),], row.names=FALSE)
RS'

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
x<-readRDS('inputs/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.rds')
ld<-attr(x,'listData', exact=TRUE)
df<-data.frame(gene=attr(x,'rownames', exact=TRUE), log2FoldChange=ld"'$log2FoldChange, padj=ld$padj)
fg<-df$gene[!is.na(df$padj) & df$padj < 0.05 & df$log2FoldChange > 1.5]
tf<-tempfile(); download.file('"'https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau', tf, quiet=TRUE); links<-read.delim(tf, header=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE); colnames(links)<-c('gene','pathway'); links"'$gene<-sub('"'"'^pau:'"','',links"'$gene); links$pathway<-sub('"'"'^path:'"','',links"'$pathway)
tf2<-tempfile(); download.file('"'https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau', tf2, quiet=TRUE); nm<-read.delim(tf2, header=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE); colnames(nm)<-c('pathway','description'); nm"'$pathway<-sub('"'"'^path:'"','',nm"'$pathway)
for(type in c('"'all_kegg','de_table')){
 universe<-if(type=='all_kegg') unique(links"'$gene) else intersect(df$gene, unique(links$gene))
 fgm<-intersect(fg, universe)
 res<-do.call(rbind,lapply(unique(links$pathway), function(pid){ gs<-intersect(unique(links$gene[links$pathway==pid]), universe); k<-sum(fgm%in%gs); data.frame(pathway=pid,n=length(gs),k=k,pvalue=phyper(k-1,length(gs),length(universe)-length(gs),length(fgm),lower.tail=FALSE)) }))
 res<-res[res$k>0 & res$n >= 10 & res$n <= 500,]
 res$padj<-p.adjust(res$pvalue,'"'BH'); res<-merge(res,nm,by='pathway',all.x=TRUE); res<-res[order(res"'$pvalue),]
 cat('"'\\n',type,'M',length(universe),'N',length(fgm),'terms',nrow(res),'\\n')
 print(res[grep('ABC transporters',res"'$description,fixed=TRUE),], row.names=FALSE)
 print(head(res,5), row.names=FALSE)
}
RS'
